title: spinecord 2D world (spinecord/world@1)
description: Units: cm and degrees. Origin bottom-left, x right, y up, heading 0 = +x, counter-clockwise-positive. The environment and the sensor placement only; the drivetrain comes from the robot profile. Validated in code by parseWorld (world.ts), which is the authority.

obstacles.description: Solid boxes: the robot stalls against them and the distance sensor sees them. Each has an id (given here, or box1, box2, ... in order) that names it while it exists.

zones.description: Coloured floor rectangles (later ones paint over earlier ones; lines paint over zones).

lines.description: Black floor lines as polylines. Line 0 is the one the follow-line task uses.

points.description: Named points: generic labels a task or a success check can refer to.

noise.description: Overrides of the default noise (see NoiseConfig in world.ts).

extensions.description: Sections owned by other packages, keyed by their name; the world model keeps them verbatim and does not interpret them. Whoever reads a section validates it.

body.description: Outline of the robot body and where its sensors sit, measured from the centre of the wheel axle (see BodyShape in world.ts). Wheel size and axle track are NOT here: they come from the robot profile.

id.description: Names the box in events and in a page's messages; unique within the world.

height_cm.description: How tall it stands. Absent: higher than any sensor looks over. A distance sensor sees it only where its beam comes down to this height (body.distance_sensor_z_cm); the touch sensor only when it reaches the bumper (body.touch_z_cm). Every box stops the body.

mass_g.description: A box the robot can push (cardboard, a cup): it slides when pushed harder than 0.4 x its weight. Absent: fixed in place.

ir_reflectivity.description: How much of the infrared sensor's light it sends back, relative to a white wall (absent: 1). Black is about 0.21: the stock firmware reads 88-90 % from black at 38 cm, 40-41 % from white. Only the infrared sensor sees it.
